# langsmith_sso_settings_by_slug (Data Source)

Read SSO provider summaries for a given **SSO login slug** via `GET /api/v1/sso/settings/{sso_login_slug}` (OpenAPI `SSOProviderSlim`). This slug-scoped endpoint returns only provider and organization identifiers; it does **not** return full SAML metadata or org provisioning defaults. For org-level SAML configuration managed in Terraform, use the `langsmith_sso_settings` resource (`/api/v1/orgs/current/sso-settings`). Email lookup and email-verification flows under `/api/v1/sso/...` are interactive-only and are not exposed as Terraform data sources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: discover which organizations expose SSO for a login slug.
# The API returns a list of SSOProviderSlim objects (see LangSmith OpenAPI).

data "langsmith_sso_settings_by_slug" "example" {
  sso_login_slug = "my-org-slug"
}

output "sso_providers_for_slug" {
  value = data.langsmith_sso_settings_by_slug.example.providers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sso_login_slug` (String) SSO login slug path parameter (`sso_login_slug` in the LangSmith OpenAPI).

### Read-Only

- `providers` (Attributes List) Organizations and provider IDs associated with this slug (OpenAPI array of `SSOProviderSlim`). May be empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `organization_display_name` (String) Human-readable organization name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization UUID.
- `provider_id` (String) SSO provider UUID.
